slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Geometry starts with three undefined terms: point, line and plane. A point marks a location and has no size. A line is straight, has no thickness and goes on forever in both directions. A plane is a flat surface that goes on forever.

On a town map, corners act like points and straight streets like lines. Two lines in the same plane either intersect in exactly one point or never meet. Lines in the same plane that never meet are parallel. Points on one line are collinear.
